dek: Two 2-4 teams that have won the last five NFC East titles meet at the Linc. Tanner McKee starts for the Hurts-less Eagles, Saquon Barkley is trending toward a return, and Dallas is a 4.5-point road favorite. Monday, 8:15 PM ET (6:15 MT), ESPN/ABC.
title: The Last Folding Chair

dek: UCF 39, BYU 31 (2OT). Two goal-line stands and a blocked field goal got BYU to overtime, but backup QB Keyone Jenkins threw for 293 yards and three touchdowns, and the Cougars' perfect season ended at the UCF 4.
title: Out of Escapes in Orlando

dek: Montana State 38, Weber State 33. The Wildcats led the No. 3 Bobcats 27-17 at halftime behind a 100-yard kickoff return and a blocked field goal, then two third-quarter fumbles started a 21-0 Montana State run.
title: David Led at the Half

dek: No. 2 BYU goes to Orlando to play a 3-3 UCF team coming off a bye. After beating Notre Dame, the job now is to avoid the letdown.
title: The Week After the Biggest Win

dek: No. 22 Weber State has won three straight and is 4-1 in the Big Sky. Next is a trip to No. 3 Montana State, the defending national champion, which beat the Wildcats 66-14 last year.
title: Three Straight, Then Bozeman

dek: After 22 wins, a lottery miracle and a franchise-altering trade, the Jazz finally have a team built to win now. Our 2026-27 season preview: what changed, what could go wrong, and whether Jamo's playoff call holds up.
label: season preview
title: Raise the Floor, Then the Roof

dek: Panthers 25, Eagles 14. Tanner McKee's first start went about how you'd expect behind a line that couldn't block a blitz, Carolina drove 90 yards to put it away, and the Birds have lost four straight for the first time since 2020.
title: Nobody Supposed This

dek: Five of the AP's top seven lost in one day, BYU is No. 2, and the playoff is reportedly headed to 24 teams in 2027. A BYU fan's opinion on the wreckage, the state of the sport and whether 24 is too many.
title: Saturday Broke the Poll. Now They Want to Double the Playoff.
updated: Sun., Oct. 18 (added the late clock start)
